answer_1.quote: For reaction condition recommendation, we adopt the approach established in prior research , which generates the reaction conditions in a specific order: catalyst, solvent 1, solvent 2, reagent 1, and reagent 2. For one-step retrosynthesis, the decoder either directly generates the SMILES strings of the reactants (i.e., a template-free approach), or predicts the reaction template first and uses cheminformatics software to derive the reactants (i.e., a template-based approach).
answer_1.outputs: Reaction conditions (catalyst, solvents, reagents) or reactants SMILES

answer_2.quote: TextReact increases the top-1 prediction accuracy by 58.4%, while the improvement in one-step retrosynthesis is 13.6-15.7%.
